title: Towards Fine-grained and Robust Detection of Human-AI Co-authorship
abstract: arXiv:2611.01427v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The widespread adoption of large language models (LLMs) is reshaping how textual content is produced, complicating text provenance, and raising concerns for misinformation, plagiarism, and intellectual property. While prior work on AI-generated text detection has progressed, one-dimensional human-AI co-authorship scores lack signals directly relevant to ``AI involvement''. It remains unclear how adversarial paraphrasing distorts detection signals. In this work, we formulate a discrete-class text provenance detection framework. This framework allows an abstraction of realistic co-authorship scenarios into distinct degrees of AI involvement, differentiating the AI polishing on the surface level from the AI updating the discourse structures. This framework reveals the mechanisms of how adversarial paraphrasing blurs the decision boundaries for co-authorship detectors. translated_title: 迈向细粒度且鲁棒的人机共著检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.01427v1 公告类型：new 摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）的广泛采用正在改变文本内容的创作方式，使文本溯源变得更加复杂，并引发了对虚假信息、剽窃和知识产权问题的担忧。尽管此前在AI生成文本检测方面已取得进展，但一维的人机共著评分缺乏与“AI参与度”直接相关的信号。此外，目前尚不清楚对抗性改写会如何扭曲检测信号。在这项工作中，我们构建了一个离散类别的文本溯源检测框架。该框架能够将现实中的共著场景抽象为不同级别的AI参与程度，从而区分表面层面的AI润色与话语结构层面的AI更新。该框架还揭示了对抗性改写如何模糊共著检测器决策边界的机制。为提升检测器的鲁棒性，我们利用对抗……来增强训练数据（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一个离散类别的文本溯源检测框架，将人机共著细分为不同级别的AI参与程度（如表面润色与话语结构更新），揭示了对抗性改写模糊检测决策边界的机制，并通过数据增强提升检测器的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a discrete-class text provenance detection framework that differentiates fine-grained degrees of AI involvement in human-AI co-authorship (e.g., surface-level polishing vs. discourse-structure updating), reveals how adversarial paraphrasing blurs detector decision boundaries, and improves detector robustness through training data augmentation.
